arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY month ORDER BY transaction_count ASC, month ASC LIMIT 3
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions per calendar month and returns the three months with the fewest, fewest first.
assumptions: Counts every transaction in the transactions table, labelled or not.
Months are calendar months from the transaction date, covering January to October 2019 as the data does.
Ties in count are broken by month, earliest first.
